policy.label: Safe Trade
policy.scope: AI risk preferences shared with native new entries; additional native guards apply. Existing stops never loosen; exits are exempt from entry frequency gates
policy.confidenceMeaning: Uncalibrated model filter, never a probability or sizing input

exampleOnly.definition: Working-limit price plus fee reserve rounded upward, then stop rounded upward. Conservative estimate; actual fill/commission basis unverified.

limitations: Offline fake HTTP/SQLite tests establish contracts, not real exchange execution.
Native attempts include no-fill/unknown reservations and preserve legacy entry/exit daily reserve.
Stop basis is a conservative working-limit plus fee estimate, not a verified actual fill/commission ledger.
Existing exchange stops are retained; tighter selected estimates block entries/model calls until verified replacement exists.
